--- title: "One player in five now plays a college season for a new school" date: "2026-10-24" description: "The share of college players spending a season at a new school rose from about 5% in 2020 to 19% in 2026, 42% of transfers stay in the same competition tier while more drop a tier than climb one, and quarterbacks and running backs drop most often (41% each)." followups: - "Test whether a transfer season or its direction changes a player's draft chance, using the outcome labels (the post's own closing question)." - "Split the transfer population by portal era once season cutoffs are agreed; pre-2016 rates are coverage floors, not estimates." - "Group of Five players drop to FCS more often than they climb to the Power conferences; check whether that holds once playing time at the old school is controlled." author: - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco" freeze: auto vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{One player in five now plays a college season for a new school} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} *Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-24.* ::: ## 1. Introduction Since the transfer portal opened in 2018 and the one-time transfer waiver arrived in 2021, changing schools no longer costs a season of play, so this post measures how often players move and whether the move is to stronger or weaker competition, with Joe Burrow, Shane Buechele, Jordan Travis, and Cam Ward as examples. + *Expecting transfers to have grown sharply since the 2021 one-time transfer rule.* + *Expecting most transfers to stay within the same competition tier.* + *Expecting players from lower tiers to move up more often than down.* + *Expecting quarterbacks and running backs to move down more often than other positions.* ## 2. Data ### 2.1 A transfer is a season played at a different school than the player's previous one The table defines the unit counted, the three competition tiers, and the three directions a move can take; rosters are thin before about 2016, so early transfer counts are lower bounds rather than estimates. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tribble( ~Term , ~Meaning , "Player-season" , "One player's college season with a recorded stat line." , "Transfer event" , "A player-season at a school different from the player's previous observed season; a gap season between the two (such as a redshirt year) does not hide the move." , "Power" , "Tier 3: the Power conferences, assigned season by season so conference realignment is followed." , "Group of Five" , "Tier 2: the other Football Bowl Subdivision conferences." , "FCS and below" , "Tier 1: Football Championship Subdivision and lower divisions." , "To a higher tier" , "The new school sits in a higher tier than the old one, for example FCS to a Power conference." , "Same tier" , "Both schools sit in the same tier." , "To a lower tier" , "The new school sits in a lower tier, for example a Power conference to the Group of Five." , "Share" , "Transfers divided by player-seasons, with a 95 percent confidence interval: the range the true rate plausibly occupies (computed by Wilson's method)." ) |> kable(caption = "The transfer terms used throughout.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The transfer terms used throughout. |Term |Meaning | |:----------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Player-season |One player's college season with a recorded stat line. | |Transfer event |A player-season at a school different from the player's previous observed season; a gap season between the two (such as a redshirt year) does not hide the move. | |Power |Tier 3: the Power conferences, assigned season by season so conference realignment is followed. | |Group of Five |Tier 2: the other Football Bowl Subdivision conferences. | |FCS and below |Tier 1: Football Championship Subdivision and lower divisions. | |To a higher tier |The new school sits in a higher tier than the old one, for example FCS to a Power conference. | |Same tier |Both schools sit in the same tier. | |To a lower tier |The new school sits in a lower tier, for example a Power conference to the Group of Five. | |Share |Transfers divided by player-seasons, with a 95 percent confidence interval: the range the true rate plausibly occupies (computed by Wilson's method). | ::: ::: ## 3. Results ### 3.1 The share of players at a new school rose almost fourfold after the 2020 season *Expecting transfers to have grown sharply since the 2021 one-time transfer rule.* ✅ The table and the first figure follow the share of players whose season is a transfer event, from under five percent through 2020 to 18.9% in 2026; the second figure splits that share by the tier of the new school. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} per_season |> filter(season %in% c(2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2024, 2026)) |> transmute( Season = season, `Player-seasons` = fmt(seasons), `At a new school` = fmt(transfers), Share = pct(share) ) |> kable( caption = sprintf( "Player-seasons at a new school, selected seasons. Over whole careers, %s of %s players (%s, 95%% CI %s to %s) changed schools at least once.", fmt(rate$transferred), fmt(rate$players), pct(rate$share), pct(ci_career["lo"]), pct(ci_career["hi"]) ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Player-seasons at a new school, selected seasons. Over whole careers, 18,463 of 134,903 players (13.7%, 95% CI 13.5% to 13.9%) changed schools at least once. | Season|Player-seasons |At a new school |Share | |------:|:--------------|:---------------|:-----| | 2016|10,258 |188 |1.8% | | 2018|11,446 |309 |2.7% | | 2020|8,027 |391 |4.9% | | 2021|13,145 |1,026 |7.8% | | 2022|15,245 |1,367 |9.0% | | 2024|15,057 |2,249 |14.9% | | 2026|16,210 |3,069 |18.9% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} trend <- per_season |> filter(season >= 2011) |> mutate( era = if_else(season >= 2021, "One-time waiver era", "Before the waiver"), tooltip = sprintf( "%d: %.1f%% of players at a new school (%s of %s)", season, 100 * share, fmt(transfers), fmt(seasons) ) ) p_trend <- ggplot(trend, aes(season, 100 * share)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 2020.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "gray70") + geom_point_interactive( aes(color = era, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = season), size = 3.4 ) + annotate( "text", x = 2011.3, y = 14, label = sprintf( "Under 5%% every season\nthrough 2020; %.1f%% in 2026", 100 * share_of(2026) ), size = 4.4, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 2016.3, y = 15, xend = 2025.6, yend = 100 * share_of(2026) + 0.4, curvature = 0.1, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "text", x = 2020.7, y = 1, label = "2021 rule", size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + scale_color_manual( values = c( "Before the waiver" = "gray45", "One-time waiver era" = "#D95F02" ) ) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 21)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2011, 2026, 3)) + labs( title = "Transfers took off once moving stopped costing a season", subtitle = "Share of player-seasons played at a new school", x = "Season", y = "Players at a new school (%)", color = NULL ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_trend, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} by_dest <- ps_change |> filter(season >= 2011, !is.na(tier)) |> group_by(season, to = factor(tier_name[as.character(tier)], tier_name)) |> summarise( seasons = n(), transfers = sum(transferred, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop" ) |> mutate(share = transfers / seasons) p_dest <- ggplot(by_dest, aes(season, 100 * share, color = to)) + geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = to, tooltip = to), linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point_interactive( aes( data_id = to, tooltip = sprintf( "%s, %d: %.1f%% of its players arrived from another school (%s of %s)", to, season, 100 * share, fmt(transfers), fmt(seasons) ) ), size = 2.6 ) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2011, 2026, 3)) + labs( title = "Every tier took on more transfers", subtitle = "Share of each tier's player-seasons played by a newcomer from another school", x = "Season", y = "Players new to their school (%)", color = "Tier of the new school", caption = "Hover a point for the counts; hover a line to isolate one tier." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_dest, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.2 Two transfers in five stay in the same tier, and more drop a tier than climb one *Expecting most transfers to stay within the same competition tier.* ✅ The table and the first figure count the 14,145 transfer events by direction, with the recurring cast as named examples; the second figure follows each direction's share season by season. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dir_tab <- tr |> count(direction_label, name = "n") |> mutate(share = n / sum(n)) dir_of <- function(d) dir_tab$share[dir_tab$direction_label == d] dir_tab |> rowwise() |> transmute( Direction = as.character(direction_label), Transfers = fmt(n), Share = pct(share), `95% CI` = sprintf( "%s to %s", pct(wilson(n, nrow(tr))["lo"]), pct(wilson(n, nrow(tr))["hi"]) ) ) |> kable(caption = "Transfer events by direction.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Transfer events by direction. |Direction |Transfers |Share |95% CI | |:----------------|:---------|:-----|:--------------| |To a higher tier |3,343 |23.6% |22.9% to 24.3% | |Same tier |5,886 |41.6% |40.8% to 42.4% | |To a lower tier |4,916 |34.8% |34.0% to 35.5% | ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ex <- tr |> filter( (player == "Joe Burrow" & season == 2018) | (player == "Shane Buechele" & season == 2019) | (player == "Jordan Travis" & season == 2019) | player == "Cameron Ward" ) |> distinct(player, season, prev_team, team, direction_label) |> arrange(player, season) ex |> transmute( Player = player, Season = season, From = prev_team, To = team, Direction = as.character(direction_label) ) |> kable(caption = "The recurring cast's transfers.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The recurring cast's transfers. |Player | Season|From |To |Direction | |:--------------|------:|:----------------|:----------------|:----------------| |Cameron Ward | 2022|Incarnate Word |Washington State |To a higher tier | |Cameron Ward | 2024|Washington State |Miami |Same tier | |Joe Burrow | 2018|Ohio State |LSU |Same tier | |Jordan Travis | 2019|Louisville |Florida State |Same tier | |Shane Buechele | 2019|Texas |SMU |To a lower tier | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} direction_label == "Same tier", tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %s transfers (%.1f%%)", direction_label, fmt(n), 100 * share ), data_id = direction_label ), width = 0.65 ) + geom_text( aes(label = scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "The most common move is sideways", subtitle = "Share of transfer events by direction", x = "Share of transfer events", y ``` ::: ::: ### 3.3 FCS players climb as often as they stay, but Group of Five players drop more than they climb *Expecting players from lower tiers to move up more often than down.* ❌ The table and the first figure cross each transfer's old tier with its new one: players leaving FCS and below cannot drop, so they climb or stay, while Group of Five players drop to FCS more often than they climb to the Power conferences; the second figure tracks each origin's direction mix by season. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} matrix_tab <- tr |> count(from, to, name = "n") |> group_by(from) |> mutate(row_share = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup() cell <- function(f, t, col = "n") { matrix_tab[[col]][matrix_tab$from == f & matrix_tab$to == t] } matrix_tab |> mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt(n), pct(row_share, 0))) |> select(From = from, to, label) |> pivot_wider(names_from = to, values_from = label, values_fill = "0") |> kable( caption = "Transfer events by old tier (rows) and new tier (columns); the percentage is the share of that row's transfers." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Transfer events by old tier (rows) and new tier (columns); the percentage is the share of that row's transfers. |From |FCS and below |Group of Five |Power | |:-------------|:-------------|:-------------|:-----------| |FCS and below |1,692 (48%) |1,242 (35%) |628 (18%) | |Group of Five |1,718 (37%) |1,470 (32%) |1,473 (32%) | |Power |987 (17%) |2,211 (37%) |2,724 (46%) | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} heat <- matrix_tab |> mutate( direction = case_when( as.integer(to) > as.integer(from) ~ "To a higher tier", as.integer(to) < as.integer(from) ~ "To a lower tier", TRUE ~ "Same tier" ), from = factor(from, rev(tier_name)), to = factor(to, tier_name), highlight = from == "Group of Five" & to %in% c("FCS and below", "Power") ) p_heat <- ggplot(heat, aes(to, from)) + geom_tile_interactive( aes( fill = direction, tooltip = sprintf( "%s to %s: %s transfers, %.0f%% of transfers leaving %s", from, to, fmt(n), 100 * row_share, from ), data_id = paste(from, to) ), color = "white", linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.85 ) + geom_tile( data = filter(heat, highlight), fill = NA, color = "#111827", linewidth = 1.4 ) + geom_text( aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%\n(%s)", 100 * row_share, fmt(n))), size = 5, fontface = "bold" ) + scale_fill_manual(values = dir_colors) + labs( title = "Group of Five players drop more often than they climb", subtitle = "Share of each old tier's transfers by new tier (rows sum to 100%)", x = "New tier", y = "Old tier", fill = NULL, caption = "Outlined: the Group of Five row's two moves, down to FCS and up to the Power conferences." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) girafe(ggobj = p_heat, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} origin_season <- tr |> filter(season >= 2016) |> count(season, from, direction_label, name = "n") |> group_by(season, from) |> mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup() p_origin <- ggplot( origin_season, aes(season, 100 * share, color = direction_label) ) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point_interactive( aes( data_id = paste(from, direction_label), tooltip = sprintf( "Leaving %s, %d: %.0f%% %s (%s transfers)", from, season, 100 * share, tolower(direction_label), fmt(n) ) ), size = 2.2 ) + facet_wrap(~from, nrow = 1) + scale_color_manual(values = dir_colors) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2016, 2021, 2026)) + labs( title = "Each origin tier's direction mix, season by season", subtitle = "Share of transfers leaving each tier, by direction, 2016 on", x = "Season", y = "Share of that tier's transfers (%)", color = NULL, caption = "Hover a point for the season's count." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_origin, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.4 Quarterbacks and running backs drop a tier more often than any other position *Expecting quarterbacks and running backs to move down more often than other positions.* ✅ The table and the first figure rank the position groups by the share of their transfers that went to a lower tier; the second figure shows each group's full direction mix. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pos_dir <- tr |> filter(group != "Position not recorded") |> count(group, direction_label, name = "n") |> group_by(group) |> mutate(share = n / sum(n), transfers = sum(n)) |> ungroup() pos_tab <- pos_dir |> select(group, transfers, direction_label, share) |> pivot_wider(names_from = direction_label, values_from = share) |> arrange(desc(`To a lower tier`)) pos_tab |> transmute( `Position group` = group, Transfers = fmt(transfers), `To a lower tier` = pct(`To a lower tier`), `Same tier` = pct(`Same tier`), `To a higher tier` = pct(`To a higher tier`) ) |> kable( caption = sprintf( "Transfer direction by position group, ordered by the share moving down. Groups pool roster codes (for example, cornerbacks and safeties are defensive backs); %d transfers with no position recorded are omitted.", sum(tr$group == "Position not recorded") ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Transfer direction by position group, ordered by the share moving down. Groups pool roster codes (for example, cornerbacks and safeties are defensive backs); 35 transfers with no position recorded are omitted. |Position group |Transfers |To a lower tier |Same tier |To a higher tier | |:--------------|:---------|:---------------|:---------|:----------------| |Quarterback |1,253 |41.3% |41.5% |17.2% | |Running back |1,458 |41.1% |39.7% |19.2% | |Receiver |2,512 |38.3% |41.0% |20.7% | |Defensive back |3,324 |35.0% |41.2% |23.9% | |Linebacker |1,685 |34.7% |41.5% |23.8% | |Defensive line |2,321 |29.6% |43.5% |27.0% | |Tight end |746 |26.8% |44.6% |28.6% | |Special teams |740 |23.4% |40.3% |36.4% | |Offensive line |71 |19.7% |50.7% |29.6% | ::: ```{.r .cell-code} down_of <- function(g) pos_tab$`To a lower tier`[pos_tab$group == g] ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} down_plot <- pos_tab |> mutate( group = reorder(group, `To a lower tier`), highlight = group %in% c("Quarterback", "Running back") ) p_down <- ggplot(down_plot, aes(100 * `To a lower tier`, group)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = highlight, tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %.1f%% of %s transfers moved to a lower tier", group, 100 * `To a lower tier`, fmt(transfers) ), data_id = group ), width = 0.7 ) + geom_text( aes( label = sprintf("%.1f%% of %s", 100 * `To a lower tier`, fmt(transfers)) ), hjust = -0.05, size = 4.2 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray65")) + guides(fill = "none") + expand_limits(x = 58) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "Quarterbacks and running backs move down most", subtitle = "Share of each position group's transfers that went to a lower tier", x = "Transfers to a lower tier", y = NULL, caption = "Offensive line counts only linemen with a stat line, a small and selected group." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_down, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mix_plot <- pos_dir |> mutate( group = factor(group, levels = rev(pos_tab$group)), direction_label = factor(direction_label, rev(names(dir_colors))) ) p_mix <- ggplot(mix_plot, aes(100 * share, group, fill = direction_label)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%s, %s: %.1f%% (%s of %s transfers)", group, tolower(direction_label), 100 * share, fmt(n), fmt(transfers) ), data_id = paste(group, direction_label) ), width = 0.7 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = dir_colors, breaks = names(dir_colors)) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "Every position's full direction mix", subtitle = "Share of each position group's transfers by direction", x = "Share of the group's transfers", y = NULL, fill = NULL, caption = "Hover a segment for the count." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_mix, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 4. Summary Three of the four expectations hold; the one that fails shows the Group of Five losing more players downward than it sends up. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tribble( ~Expectation , ~Verdict , ~Evidence , "Transfers grew sharply after the 2021 rule" , "✅" , sprintf("Under 5%% of player-seasons every season through 2020; %s in 2026.", pct(share_of(2026))) , "Most transfers stay in the same tier" , "✅" , sprintf("%s same tier, %s down, %s up.", pct(dir_of("Same tier")), pct(dir_of("To a lower tier")), pct(dir_of("To a higher tier"))) , "Lower-tier players move up more often than down" , "❌" , sprintf("Group of Five players dropped to FCS %s times and climbed to the Power conferences %s times.", fmt(cell("Group of Five", "FCS and below")), fmt(cell("Group of Five", "Power"))) , "Quarterbacks and running backs move down the most" , "✅" , sprintf("%s of quarterback and %s of running back transfers moved down, the two highest.", pct(down_of("Quarterback")), pct(down_of("Running back"))) ) |> kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Each expectation and what the data showed. |Expectation |Verdict |Evidence | |:-------------------------------------------------|:-------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |Transfers grew sharply after the 2021 rule |✅ |Under 5% of player-seasons every season through 2020; 18.9% in 2026. | |Most transfers stay in the same tier |✅ |41.6% same tier, 34.8% down, 23.6% up. | |Lower-tier players move up more often than down |❌ |Group of Five players dropped to FCS 1,718 times and climbed to the Power conferences 1,473 times. | |Quarterbacks and running backs move down the most |✅ |41.3% of quarterback and 41.1% of running back transfers moved down, the two highest. | ::: ::: ## 5. Discussion ::: {.callout-important} The transfer count is a floor. - A move is visible only when both seasons carry a stat line, so a player who transfers and never records another statistic is not counted. - Roster coverage is thin before about 2016, so the early rates are lower bounds, and part of the rise reflects growing coverage; the climb after 2020 is steep and sustained, and it lines up with the rule change. ::: ::: {.callout-important} Direction is measured against competition tiers, not programs. - A move between two Power programs counts as same tier even when the new program is far stronger. - The 796 player-seasons whose team changed tier through conference realignment, without the player changing schools, are not transfers and are excluded. ::: ::: {.callout-important} Depth charts plausibly explain the position pattern. - Quarterbacks and running backs at large programs compete in long depth charts, and the next available starting job is often one tier down. - Specialists climb most often: kicking and punting jobs are few, and a specialist's route to a Power program often starts at a smaller one. :::
